jobs.name: second-brain-inbox-digest
jobs.prompt:
Call the brain_digest tool with no arguments. If the Inbox has no items (inbox count 0), reply with exactly: Inbox empty.
Otherwise reply with the digest text the tool returned, unchanged: inbox count, oldest age, one line per item with its warnings. Add one last line: Reply "review inbox" to go through these.
Rules: do not approve, discard, edit, or capture anything in this job. Do not summarise or reorder the items. No preamble and no sign-off. If the tool fails, reply with the exact error text and nothing else.

jobs.name: second-brain-weekly-report
jobs.prompt:
Call the brain_report tool with no arguments. Write the weekly second-brain report from its result, for reading on a phone, under 250 words. Use these sections and omit any that are empty: Likely duplicates, Notes with no links and no map, Tags without a map, Inbox items older than 14 days, Orphan sources. Name notes by title. If every section is empty, reply with exactly: Nothing to report this week.
Rules: the report is read-only. Do not approve, discard, merge, delete, edit, or capture anything in this job. Do not invent findings the tool did not return. No preamble and no sign-off. If the tool fails, reply with the exact error text and nothing else.
